Calculate Option-Adjusted Spread (OAS)

Source: R/oas-calculation.r
calculate_oas.Rd

Calculates the option-adjusted spread for a security with embedded options.

Usage

calculate_oas(
  asset_data,
  rate_paths,
  prepay_model,
  market_price,
  deal_structure = NULL,
  search_range = c(-500, 500),
  tolerance = 0.01,
  max_iterations = 50,
  verbose = TRUE,
  reference_key = "10",
  discounting = c("path", "spot"),
  accrual_method = "30/360",
  start_date = NULL,
  terminal_balance = c("return", "drop"),
  recovery_basis = c("defaults", "balance")
)

Arguments

asset_data

Data frame. Asset data with loan characteristics

rate_paths

List. The result from simulate_rates

prepay_model

List. Prepayment model from prepayment_model

market_price

Numeric. Market price of the security (as a percentage of par)

deal_structure

List. Optional deal structure for structured securities

search_range

Numeric vector. Range of OAS values to search (in basis points)

tolerance

Numeric. Tolerance for price convergence

max_iterations

Integer. Maximum number of iterations for the search

verbose

Logical. Whether to print progress information

reference_key

Character. Key of the reference rate used for credit vectors, discounting, and as the index for any variable rate loans or floating rate bonds. Defaults to the 10-year.

discounting

Character. Passed to calculate_present_value: "path" compounds the short rate along each path, "spot" reproduces the earlier behaviour.

accrual_method

Character. Day-count convention passed to project_cashflows when the asset data carries no accrual_method or Accrual column of its own.

start_date

Date. Anchor for the payment schedule, needed by the ACT conventions. Passed to project_cashflows.

terminal_balance

Character. Passed to project_cashflows: whether the balance outstanding at the horizon is returned as a final cash flow or dropped.

recovery_basis

Character. Passed to project_cashflows: whether recovery is taken on the amount that defaulted or on the balance standing at the time.

Value

A list containing the OAS calculation results

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Get DNS parameters and simulate rate paths
dns_params <- dnsr::get_calibrated_dns_params()
rate_paths <- simulate_rates(dns_params, n_paths = 100)

# Define prepayment model
prepay_model <- prepayment_model(type = "cpr_cdr", base_cpr = 0.06, base_cdr = 0.01)

# Calculate OAS
oas_result <- calculate_oas(asset_data, rate_paths, prepay_model, market_price = 101.5)
} # }
